Frequently asked questions

Can I watch the cameras on my phone?

Yes. We set up remote viewing so you can see live and recorded footage from your phone.

Do you install CCTV for villas and homes?

Yes — for villas and homes as well as shops, offices and warehouses.

Can you upgrade our old CCTV system?

Yes. We can reuse what still works and replace what doesn’t, or move you to IP cameras.
